name: Baikal NT200
summary: Historical underwater neutrino-experiment series in Lake Baikal, searching the Sun, Galactic center, dwarf galaxies and other directions for dark matter. Cataloged separately from its successor GVD.
detection_principle: Underwater optical modules detect Cherenkov light from neutrino-induced secondary muons; signal spatial distributions are compared with backgrounds.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: Historical NT200 data analysis; no unverified precise final shutdown date is supplied here.

key_parameters.name: NT200
key_parameters.value: 192 optical modules / 8 strings, at about 1.1 km depth

results.summary: Reanalyzed 1998–2003 data to search for dark-matter neutrinos from the Galactic center.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.

media.caption: Deployment diagram of the central eight-string NT200 array and three additional NT200+ strings. The dense central part is NT200; the long outer strings belong to the 2005 upgrade.
